operation: jq: {library,request,counts,section_outcomes, member_sample: (.members | if type=="array" then .[0] else (to_entries|.[0]) end),type_sample:(.types | if type=="array" then .[0] else (to_entries|.[0]) end),parameter_keys:(.parameter_type_members|keys|.[0:12]),return_keys:(.return_type_members|keys|.[0:12]),produced_keys:(.produced_type_members|keys|.[0:12]),attribute_keys:(.attribute_type_members|keys|.[0:12]),name_word_keys:(.name_word_types|keys|.[0:12])}

jq: [.produced_type_members["T:System.Text.Json.JsonDocument"][] as $id | .members[] | select(.documentation_id==$id) | {id:.documentation_id,type:.declaring_type,signature:.display_signature,return_type:.return_type,parameters:.parameters,documentation:(if .name=="ParseAsync" then .documentation else empty end)}]

jq: [.parameter_type_members["T:System.IO.Stream"][] as $id | .members[] | select(.documentation_id==$id) | {id:.documentation_id,type:.declaring_type,signature:.display_signature,accessibility:.accessibility,source:(if .declaring_type=="T:System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer" and .name=="Deserialize" then .source else empty end)}]

jq error: [.types["T:System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter"].required_overrides[],.types["T:System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverterFactory"].required_overrides[],.types["T:System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter`1"].required_overrides[]] | unique as $ids | [.members[] | select(.documentation_id as $id | $ids|index($id)) | {type:.declaring_type,signature:.display_signature,accessibility:.accessibility}]

jq: . as $d | [.attribute_type_members["T:System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.RequiresUnreferencedCodeAttribute"][] as $id | .members[] | select(.documentation_id==$id) | {type:.declaring_type,name:.name}] | unique | map(. as $key | {type:.type,name:.name,unmarked:([$d.members[] | select(.declaring_type==$key.type and .name==$key.name and ((.attribute_types|index("T:System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.RequiresUnreferencedCodeAttribute"))==null)) | .display_signature])})

jq: . as $d | ([.types["T:System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter"].required_overrides[],.types["T:System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverterFactory"].required_overrides[],.types["T:System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter`1"].required_overrides[]] | unique) as $ids | [$d.members[] | select(.documentation_id as $id | $ids|index($id)) | {type:.declaring_type,signature:.display_signature,accessibility:.accessibility}]
